origin.description: Builds an ASCII string in which non-printable and non-ASCII characters are escape sequences.
origin.details: Bell, backspace, tab, newline, vertical tab, form feed, and carriage return become \a, \b, \t, \n, \v, \f, and \r. Quote, apostrophe, and backslash are escaped. ESC is \u001b, not \e. Other code points at or below U+FFFF use \u and four lowercase hex digits. Higher code points use \U and eight lowercase hex digits. Printable ASCII from space through tilde is left as itself. A missing value stays missing.

translation.description: Builds an ASCII string in which non-printable and non-ASCII characters are escape sequences.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, or a list of strings and stringi._na.NA.

translation.details: Matches stri_escape.cpp. The named controls are \a through \r, plus quote, apostrophe, and backslash. ESC is \u001b. Hex digits are lowercase. Latin-1 and other BMP characters use \uXXXX. An emoji uses \UXXXXXXXX. Code points are escaped one at a time, so a single character above U+FFFF is one \U escape.
translation.value: A list of ASCII strings. A missing input stays NA.
